Then, on the night of her 45th birthday, the seal shattered. The fox spirit—no longer willing to be caged—awoke, rewriting her very being. In an instant, Sayuri Nakamura ceased to exist. The only certainty is that the hunger inside her grows stronger by the day… and she has no intention of resisting it.
